subject: Vectra Labs renewal: hosted API commit & tier uplift
messages:
From: Asha Reddy <asha@vectra-labs.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@vectra-labs.com>
Date: 2027-04-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal planning: request to increase hosted API commit

Hi Grace,

We're in the middle of our budget cycle and want to confirm renewal numbers for Vectra Labs. Current committed throughput on the hosted API is 2M tokens/month (monthly billing). Usage has spiked with the new recommendation engine; projected steady-state is ~4.8M tokens/month and short bursts up to ~7M.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood provide a pricing sketch for moving to a 5M monthly commit (annualized) and the corresponding rate bands (unit token price / overage rules)?
- We need clarity on soft throttle/burst behavior: under the proposed commit, what happens at sustained 30% above commit vs short spikes? Any guaranteed burst pockets?

Also including Tom (engineering) to confirm that response latency objectives (p95 < 300ms for short responses) remain achievable. We plan to finalize procurement by May 20; please advise what you need from our side (PO, contact, SLA exceptions).

Thanks,
Asha
Asha Reddy
Head of Platform
Vectra Labs
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Reddy <asha@vectra-labs.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@vectra-labs.com>
Date: 2027-04-17T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning: request to increase hosted API commit

Hi Asha — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. Looping Ben (AE) and Marissa (Renewals) to own pricing and contract changes.

Quick answers up-front:
- We can propose an annual 5M tokens/month committed tier. I pulled a preliminary pricing sketch and included a draft addendum (20270417-vectra-addon-draft.pdf) that shows 1) commit, 2) tiered unit price, 3) overage bands, and 4) a 10% annual-commit discount compared to pay-as-you-go.
- For bursts: we offer a soft-burst pocket equal to 20% of the monthly commit that can be used without penalty. Sustained usage > commit + burst for more than 72 hours triggers our soft-throttle policy (we throttle throughput to preserve latency SLOs and route to compatible lower-cost model variants if requested). We can carve additional temporary burst capacity for predictable seasonal spikes — details in the addendum.

Next steps we suggest:
1) Ben to confirm final unit prices and any promotional concession.
2) Marissa will prepare a short addendum to the existing SOW (vectra_sow_addendum.docx) and a DocuSign link once we agree terms.
3) If procurement needs a formal SLA exception for the latency p95, we can escalate to our reliability team — please describe the necessary SLA target in the PO.

I attached the draft for review. If it looks good we can do a 30-minute sync tomorrow to lock numbers.

- Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Sales Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Reddy <asha@vectra-labs.com>, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@vectra-labs.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning: request to increase hosted API commit

Hi Asha — great to hear the product is scaling. A few pricing specifics and one ask from procurement perspective:

Pricing options (annualized, billed monthly):
- Option A (Standard): 5M token/month commit, $0.0018 per token up to commit. Overage tiers: 0.5x unit price for first 10% over, 1.0x unit price beyond that. Soft-burst pocket = 20% of commit. No early termination.
- Option B (Performance): 5M token/month commit + reserved burst (additional 1M tokens/month) for a +20% guaranteed cushion. $0.0020 per token, includes priority routing and a 99.9% uptime SLA on the hosted control plane.

Concession we can offer for an annual signature and PO by May 20: 7% off the base unit price on Option A (so $0.001674/token). That concession requires a single PO referencing deal VL-2345 and a standard one-year addendum.

Procurement ask: please confirm billing cadence preference (monthly invoice vs. consolidated quarterly invoice) and whether Vectra requires any specific invoicing fields (PO number format, remit-to). We can accommodate standard PO numbers and provide an invoice CSV.

I attached an internal pricing worksheet; Grace will publish the formal addendum. Happy to hop on a call to walk through numbers.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Asha Reddy <asha@vectra-labs.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@vectra-labs.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-19T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning: request to increase hosted API commit

Thanks Ben and Grace — this is helpful. A couple clarifications from our side:
- We prefer Option A with the 7% concession. Can you confirm that the soft-burst pocket is non-billable up to 20%/month (i.e., only overage pricing applies after that)?
- We need the first billing period to start June 1 (aligned with our fiscal calendar) — contract effective date can be May 15 if that makes procurement easier, but invoices should begin 2027-06-01.
- SLA: p95 < 300ms is critical for our user flows. If you can provide the SLA exception in writing we'll append it to the PO.

Procurement details: we use the PO format VL-PO-2027-####. We'll route the PO once we have the DocuSign addendum and a final invoice template.

If you can circulate the final addendum today, I can get the PO started this week.

Best,
Asha
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Reddy <asha@vectra-labs.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@vectra-labs.com>
Date: 2027-04-21T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning: request to increase hosted API commit & next steps

Asha — great, thanks for confirming Option A and the billing start date. Action items and commitments from Redwood: 

1) Contracting: Marissa will issue a short addendum (vectra_sow_addendum.docx) capturing: 5M token/month commit, 7% concession, non-billable soft-burst pocket up to 20%/month, overage bands as outlined, and effective date May 15 with invoices starting 2027-06-01. Expect a DocuSign link within 24 hours: https://app.docusign.com/exec?token=abcdef123456

2) SLA note: We will include a written SLA exception for p95 < 300ms for the agreed endpoints. Our reliability team will review the specific endpoint list if Tom sends it; otherwise we'll include a general clause and escalate if you need a tighter SLA later.

3) Procurement: please send PO as VL-PO-2027-XXXX referencing deal VL-2345. For invoicing cadence, we'll default to monthly invoices unless you request consolidated quarterly billing.

4) Handoff: after signed addendum + PO, Ben will hand off to CS (technical onboarding) and schedule a provisioning window. We'll include a brief ops checklist so you see the capacity allocation timeline.

Attachments: final addendum + invoice template will be attached to the DocuSign envelope.

If that matches what you expect, I'll mark the deal as 'contract pending' in HubSpot and send the DocuSign link.

Thanks — we'll get this over today.

— Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Sales Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
